name: Entombed Stonemason
descr: An unfortunate undead laborer chosen by lottery to wall up their empress's tomb from the inside.

data.motivesAndTactics: Never stop working, sacrifice yourself for the empress

features.name: Minion
features.text: The Stonemason is defeated when they take any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Stonemason, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range their attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Entombed Stonemasons within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: The Work Never Ends
features.text: When the Stonemason is defeated by an attack that deals physical damage, you can **spend a Fear** to clear the Stonemason's HP and Stress.
